title: 第99章 残废的赵霸

第99章 残废的赵霸-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

破格提拔！

眼前这个沈站长……不对，现在应该叫沈局长了，能量肯定是不小的，而林业局主管的就是林业方面，包括狩猎这方面，要是能和眼前这人关系拉近，好处多多。

比如说，在购买猎枪和子弹方面，就有天然的优势。

现在购买猎枪，一个是联系厂商，一个是黑市，一个是林业供销站，但是需要审批，而作为林业局的副局长，什么审批不过是一句话的事情，公社化也即将到来，上面能有个人帮衬一下，自己建立的香獐子饲养厂，也不会被被人惦记。

黑市猎枪的价格更贵一些。

“恭喜沈局长！”李青山开口道。

今天入账六十六块五毛，加上自己身上攒的钱，共计一百六十五块五毛钱，距离建造大瓦房还有有些距离，不过按照这个赚钱速度，再下河电几次鱼，等到供销社帮忙买的子弹到货，再上山一次。

第一套大瓦房的宅子，稳了！

趁着现在天色还早，李青山带着大壮等人准备再去电一波，然后再拉到市场上来卖，毕竟很多人根本就没抢到，不过再电一批回来后，刚好赶到正午，要是短时间内倾销不出去的话，肥鱼可就不新鲜了。

就当试试水吧。

要是中午也能畅销，以后自己就一天拉两趟，早晨卖一趟，中午卖一趟！

当即。

李青山带着大壮和赵红旗等人，开始朝着沙河的方向赶了过去。

“山哥，明天要不要把我爹喊出来帮忙，这样咱们就有五个人了，两个人拉一辆木板车，咱们一次拉两车鱼去市场卖，也省得咱们一趟趟回来了。”

“这样的话，咱们一趟就能卖一千斤鱼。”

大壮一边推着木板车，一边开口道。

“咱们的人手，确实太少了，要是能再来几个知心的人入伙倒是不错，不过你爹都四十多岁了，一大把年纪，这么搞太累了吧？”

李青山开口问道。

“哪有，我爹今年才四十六岁，正是闯的你就按几，肯定可以的，他在家闲着也没啥事，多帮忙赚点钱，我和二壮也能早点娶媳妇，让他早点抱上孙子不是吗？”

大壮一脸憨厚道。

“还别说，你小子还挺孝顺，哈哈……！”李青山忍不住笑出声道：“今天回去你就和你爹商量一下吧，要是可以的话，明天早们就拉两辆木板车来，然后凌晨三点准时出发，到了沙河准备准备后，刚好天亮，咱们立刻动手！”

“行！”

大壮郑重点了点头，脸上满是兴奋之色。

自己一家三口，按照商量好的，一天可就是六块钱啊，多少人家一个月也攒不到六块钱，这下自己和二壮的媳妇，可算是有了着落，推起嘎吱嘎吱的木板车来，也更有力量了。

Chapter 99 The Crippled Zhao Ba - "Climbing the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

An exceptional promotion!

The Station Commander Shen in front of me... No, he should be called Director Shen now. He must have a lot of energy, and the Forestry Bureau is in charge of forestry, including hunting. If you can get closer to the person in front of you, there will be many benefits.

For example, there are natural advantages when it comes to purchasing shotguns and bullets.

Nowadays, when buying a shotgun, one has to contact the manufacturer, the black market, and the forestry supply and marketing station, but it requires approval. As the deputy director of the Forestry Bureau, approval is just a matter of one sentence. The commune is coming soon. If there is someone above to help, the fragrant deer breeding factory established by oneself will not be missed.

Black market shotguns are more expensive.

"Congratulations to Director Shen!" Li Qingshan said.

Today I earned 66 yuan and 50 cents, plus the money I saved, the total is 165 yuan and 50 cents. There is still a long way to go before I can build a big tile house. But at this rate of making money, I will go down the river a few times to fish, and when the bullets bought by the supply and marketing cooperative arrive, I can go up the mountain again.

The first big tile-roofed house is stable!

Taking advantage of the fact that it was still early in the day, Li Qingshan, Da Zhuang and others planned to go to the market to sell some more fish. After all, many people didn't get it at all. However, after calling another batch, they arrived just in time for noon. If they couldn't be sold out in a short time, the fat fish wouldn't be new.

Just try the waters.

If it can sell well at noon, I will sell it twice a day from now on, one in the morning and one at noon!

Immediately.

Li Qingshan took Da Zhuang, Zhao Hongqi and others and started to rush towards Shahe.

"Brother Shan, why don't you call my dad out to help tomorrow? Then there will be five of us. Two people will pull a wooden cart. We can pull two carts of fish at a time to sell in the market, which will save us the trip back."

"In this case, we can sell a thousand catties of fish in one trip."

Da Zhuang said while pushing the wooden cart.

"Our manpower is indeed too small. It would be nice to have a few more intimate people join us, but your father is already in his forties, so he is quite old. Isn't it too tiring to do this?"

Li Qingshan asked.

"No way, my father is only forty-six years old this year. Just press a few times for him. You can definitely do it. He has nothing to do at home. If he helps out and makes some money, Erzhuang and I can get a wife sooner and let him have a grandchild sooner, right?"

Da Zhuang looked honest and honest.

"Not to mention, you are quite filial, haha...!" Li Qingshan couldn't help but laugh out loud: "You should discuss it with your father when you go back today. If possible, we will bring two wooden carts here tomorrow morning, and then set off on time at three o'clock in the morning. After arriving in Shahe to prepare, it will be dawn, let's start immediately!"

"Okay!"

Da Zhuang nodded solemnly, his face full of excitement.

My family of three, as agreed upon, can only earn six yuan a day. Many families can't save six yuan a month. Now I and my second wife have a place to live, and they have more strength to push the creaking wooden cart.
